response.justification: Bogdan is a broadly experienced, senior-level engineer with strong systems fundamentals, developer-tooling instincts, and a rare touch of IDE work (C components for NI LabWindows/CVI). However, the role demands deep JVM expertise — Java, Kotlin, Spring, Hibernate, Quarkus, build tools, and application servers — and the resume shows only peripheral Java usage (robotic arms and a device orchestration tool, 2016–2018), no Kotlin, and no Spring or enterprise-framework experience at all. The last decade is concentrated in TypeScript/Node.js and D, which does not map to the enterprise JVM tooling core of this position. The gap is in the primary required skill set, not in seniority or engineering quality.
strengths: Prior IDE development experience (NI LabWindows/CVI) and strong dev-tooling focus
Deep systems/low-latency background (D, C/C++, high-throughput microservices)
Strong testing craftsmanship, OSS ownership, and demonstrated communication via talks/workshops
concerns: No Spring, Hibernate, Quarkus, or enterprise JVM framework experience
Kotlin absent; Java usage is dated and limited to secondary project work
Recent decade centered on TypeScript/Node and D, far from the JVM ecosystem

key_factors.factor: Complex systems and large-codebase track record
